Active Directory replication - check

Domain: corp.example.com

1. Summary of all domain controllers:
   repadmin /replsummary

2. Details of the controller that reports errors:
   repadmin /showrepl controllerq3xwz7a2kfm4ub6tyc5nre.d.example.net

3. Start a replication by hand:
   repadmin /syncall controllerq3xwz7a2kfm4ub6tyc5nre.d.example.net /AdeP

If the errors remain, call Infrastructure team.
